commandsRun.observation: 70 committed tests passed. Verbose output showed heavy-chain numbered-result and germline-assignment cases for all allowed species (human, mouse, macaque, rhesus, rabbit, rat, cow, chicken, alpaca, cat, dog, pig), all committed light-chain contract cases passed, and the renumbering-level rhesus/macaque backward-compat tests passed.

Evidence-only helper produced 3 passes and 2 failures. It confirmed numbered-result and germline-assignment decorators cover every allowed species, confirmed non-human light-chain coverage matches supported chains, showed the HMM-loading test is loop-based rather than @pytest.mark.parametrize, and showed Airr("rhesus") raises BadDataSet even though downstream run_mutational_analysis with reference_name="rhesus" matched macaque mutation calls.

assertions.reason: Committed heavy-chain coverage passes for all allowed species, but the HMM-loading check is not pytest-parametrized. test_all_allowed_species_have_hmms iterates over Renumbering.get_allowed_species() in a for-loop, so individual HMM-loading cases do not appear as separate parametrized tests as required by the contract.

Committed TestLightChainContract cases all passed for supported non-human light chains. Kappa coverage passed for macaque, mouse, rabbit, rat, cow, cat, dog, and pig; lambda coverage passed for those species plus chicken, matching the supported-chain contract.

The committed renumbering-level rhesus/macaque tests pass, but the full user-facing flow does not. Evidence-only pytest showed Airr("rhesus") fails immediately with BadDataSet because "rhesus" is not an available AIRR dataset name (available datasets include "macaque" and "rhesus_macaque", not "rhesus"). A downstream control using reference_name="rhesus" still produced the same mutation calls as macaque, so the break is specifically at the Airr entry point.

frictions: During the full-flow helper run, Airr("macaque") emitted a reference-builder warning about missing IMGT V-region position columns and fell back to the direct germlines-module path; the macaque control still completed successfully.
